mechanism_variables: sympathetic_reactivity_index (EDA peak amplitude per stressor, µS)
coverage_indicator (binary: true label in prediction set)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: High autonomic reactivity -> extreme physiological feature values (ECG, EDA, respiration) outside training distribution -> inflated nonconformity scores -> shrunken prediction sets -> undercoverage for high-reactivity subjects
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Positive correlation between sympathetic_reactivity_index and undercoverage (higher reactivity leads to lower coverage rate)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Subjects in top quartile of EDA peak amplitude during stress trials
Mondrian taxonomy stratified only by stress condition labels (baseline, stress, recovery)
Calibration set does not include subject-level autonomic gain as a stratification variable
measurable_outcomes: Per-subject coverage rate (proportion of windows with true label in prediction set)
Correlation coefficient between sympathetic_reactivity_index and coverage rate
Distribution of prediction_set_size across reactivity quantiles
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Mechanism hinges on the mismatch between coarse Mondrian strata and continuous autonomic reactivity. Test by adding reactivity as a covariate in stratification and measuring coverage improvement.

mechanism_variables: electrode_impedance (ohms, measured at start and end of session)
EDA_amplitude (µS, mean phasic peak amplitude per trial)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Prolonged recording -> gradual electrode impedance increase -> reduced EDA amplitude -> feature distribution shift relative to calibration set -> biased nonconformity estimates (too low) -> undercoverage for later trials
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Negative correlation between session_time_elapsed and coverage rate; positive correlation between impedance change and undercoverage magnitude
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Wrist-worn EDA sensor (Empatica E4 or equivalent) used for >60 minutes
Mondrian bins defined by experimental condition only, not sensor health state
Ambient temperature relatively stable (to isolate sensor drift)
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate per trial order (early vs. late trials)
Linear trend of EDA_amplitude across session_time_elapsed
Impedance change (end - start) vs. coverage drop in last trial block
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Requires impedance logs or proxy (e.g., signal quality index). Test by recalibrating nonconformity scores using only early-session data and evaluating late-session coverage.

mechanism_variables: autonomic_transition_rate (absolute change in RMSSD per minute)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Rapid autonomic transitions (stress onset/recovery) -> temporal dependence in residuals (violating exchangeability) -> conformal algorithm treats windows as independent -> underestimated prediction interval width -> undercoverage during transitional periods
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Higher autonomic_transition_rate predicts lower coverage; positive residual_autocorrelation associated with undercoverage
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Stress-recovery transitions in WESAD protocol (e.g., TSST to recovery)
Mondrian strata defined by static condition labels (stress vs. recovery)
Window length 30s with 50% overlap
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate in transitional windows (first 2 min after condition change) vs. stable windows
Lag-1 autocorrelation of nonconformity scores within subjects
Calibration of prediction interval width vs. empirical error quantiles per transition phase
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Test by adding temporal block bootstrap or using time-aware conformal methods (e.g., conformal prediction with dependent data) and comparing coverage.

mechanism_variables: physiological_stress_index (classifier probability of high stress from multimodal features)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Subjects under-report stress -> placed in low-stress stratum despite high physiological arousal -> nonconformity distribution in low-stress stratum becomes too narrow (misses high-arousal patterns) -> undercoverage for mislabeled subjects in low-stress stratum
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Higher label_noise_indicator rate in low-stress stratum predicts lower coverage for that stratum; coverage gap between noisy and clean labels
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Self-report collected via post-hoc questionnaire (not continuous)
Mondrian taxonomy uses self-report as ground truth for stratification
Physiological stress index derived from independent classifier (e.g., SVM on ECG+EDA)
measurable_outcomes: Stratum-specific coverage (low-stress vs. high-stress)
Proportion of label_noise_indicator=1 in low-stress stratum
Nonconformity score distribution width (e.g., IQR) per stratum
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Can be tested by relabeling using physiological index and re-running Mondrian; coverage should improve if mislabeling is the cause.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Older age (>50) -> different baseline HRV/EDA ranges -> shared nonconformity quantile across ages is too optimistic for older subjects -> prediction sets too small -> undercoverage for older demographic
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Negative correlation between age and coverage rate; coverage for age>50 significantly below nominal level
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: WESAD cohort includes subjects aged 20-60 but calibration set skewed <40
Mondrian taxonomy does not include age as stratification variable
Baseline HRV/EDA differ significantly by age group (p<0.05)
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate per age bin (e.g., 20-30, 30-40, 40-50, 50+)
Baseline HRV and EDA means per age bin
Conditional quantile estimate vs. empirical quantile per age bin
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Test by adding age as a Mondrian stratification variable or using weighted conformal prediction to adjust for demographic imbalance.

mechanism_variables: softmax_margin (difference between top two class probabilities)
multimodal_correlation (canonical correlation between ECG, EDA, respiration feature sets)
out_of_distribution_score (Mahalanobis distance in joint feature space)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Margin-based nonconformity ignores cross-modal correlations -> overly confident scores for out-of-distribution multimodal patterns (e.g., high EDA but low HRV reactivity) -> nonconformity scores too low for such patterns -> prediction sets exclude true label -> undercoverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Higher out_of_distribution_score predicts lower coverage; negative interaction between softmax_margin and multimodal_correlation on coverage
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Multimodal features: ECG (HRV), EDA (phasic/tonic), respiration (rate, variability)
Nonconformity score = 1 - softmax_margin (standard classification margin)
Mondrian strata do not account for feature geometry
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate as function of out_of_distribution_score quantiles
Calibration curve: nonconformity score vs. empirical error rate
Coverage improvement when using Mahalanobis-based nonconformity vs. margin-based
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Design problem-specific nonconformity (e.g., distance to class centroid in multimodal space) and compare coverage on held-out subjects.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Day-specific ambient temperature/humidity -> altered skin conductance baseline -> EDA feature distribution shift -> conformal predictor treats all days as exchangeable within condition -> nonconformity quantiles miscalibrated for days with extreme conditions -> undercoverage on those days
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Days with larger deviation of ambient_temperature/humidity from calibration day mean show lower coverage; negative correlation between baseline shift magnitude and coverage
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: WESAD recordings span multiple days with varying lab conditions
Mondrian condition labels do not include day or environment
EDA baseline measured during neutral baseline period each day
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate per recording day
Correlation between daily ambient_temperature/humidity and coverage
EDA baseline shift (day baseline - grand mean baseline) vs. coverage drop
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Test by adding day as a stratification variable or by normalizing EDA per day using baseline; measure coverage recovery.

mechanism_variables: stratum_sample_size (number of calibration points per condition-subject stratum)
conditional_quantile_estimate (empirical quantile of nonconformity scores in stratum)
oracle_quantile (true conditional quantile estimated via large holdout or cross-validation)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Mondrian splits calibration data into many condition-subject strata -> strata with few samples (e.g., rare stress levels) yield noisy quantile estimates biased low -> prediction sets too small -> systematic undercoverage for rare stress levels
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Negative correlation between stratum_sample_size and coverage rate; quantile estimation bias (estimate - oracle) negative for small strata
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: WESAD has 15 subjects, 3 conditions -> up to 45 strata; some strata have <20 calibration windows
Nominal coverage 90% (alpha=0.1)
Asymptotic guarantees assumed but finite-sample bias present
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate vs. stratum_sample_size (binned)
Mean quantile estimation bias per stratum size bin
Coverage after applying finite-sample correction (e.g., +1 adjustment) vs. standard Mondrian
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Use bootstrap to estimate quantile bias; test corrected quantile (e.g., using order statistic with adjusted index) on held-out data.

mechanism_variables: EDA_peak_amplitude (max phasic peak per trial, µS)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Repeated stress exposure -> habituation attenuates EDA peaks and HRV reactivity -> later-trial feature vectors shift toward non-stress distribution -> nonconformity calibration based on early-trial statistics (larger reactivity) -> nonconformity scores too low for later trials -> undercoverage
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Negative correlation between trial_number and coverage rate; EDA_peak_amplitude and HRV_reactivity decrease with trial_number
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: WESAD includes three stress trials (TSST, mental arithmetic, cold pressor) per subject
Mondrian taxonomy treats each trial as identically distributed given stress label
Habituation defined as significant linear trend (p<0.05) in reactivity across trials
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate per trial_number
Linear trend of EDA_peak_amplitude and HRV_reactivity across trials
Nonconformity score distribution shift (e.g., KS test) between trial 1 and trial 3
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Test by stratifying Mondrian by trial number or using adaptive conformal prediction that updates calibration set with recent trials.

mechanism_variables: respiration_missingness_indicator (1 if respiration belt data missing in window)
imputed_respiration_features (mean imputation or last value carried forward)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: High movement during stress -> respiration belt artifacts -> missing respiration data -> imputed/omitted features shift joint distribution away from calibration distribution -> nonconformity score computed on available modalities underestimates uncertainty -> undercoverage during high-movement stress periods
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Higher movement_intensity predicts higher respiration_missingness; windows with missing respiration have lower coverage, especially during stress condition
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Respiration belt (Respiban) prone to motion artifacts during physical stress
Missingness not at random: correlated with movement_intensity and stress_level
Conformal predictor uses mean imputation and ignores missingness mechanism
measurable_outcomes: Coverage rate stratified by respiration_missingness_indicator and stress_level
Missingness rate per stress_level and movement_intensity quartile
Nonconformity score distribution for missing vs. non-missing windows
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Test by incorporating missingness as a feature (e.g., missingness indicator) or using multiple imputation with conformal prediction; compare coverage.
